title: A one-hop read through a lookup an object extension adds is accepted with a misspelt target field, then refuses every save
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up the #33154 contract review surfaced (record 6870963898 F2 on PR #33205, measured real by the implementer); out of that card's scope by ruling, recorded in the PR's changeset Unchanged line.
Business reason: a validation rule or formula that reads `record.<lookup>.<field>` through a lookup field an extension adds has its `<field>` leaf unjudged at `os build` and at the publish door. A misspelt column behind that lookup is accepted in Studio, and then every save of the object fails for end users. The same read through a lookup the object declares itself is judged today.
Reader who acts: the owner of `packages/lint` `validate-expressions.ts` (`refuseUndeclaredHopField` and `storedMetadataBodyReferencesFor`, which read the declared `objects`, not the served fold with extensions).

## 维护者速读

通过“对象扩展新增的查找字段”做一跳读取时（`record.查找字段.目标字段`），目标字段名写错在发布门和 `os build` 都不报错，要到最终用户保存记录时才全部失败。对象自身声明的查找字段走同样读取时是判定的。

## Expected

The one-hop leaf is judged against the referenced object as served, whether the lookup field is declared by the object or added by an extension, at the build and at every door that runs the expression passes.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open extension lookup hop` checked at filing. Related: #33154, #33072, #32875.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
